name: River Grab

card.plain: Lunge and seize a standing foe; a grab can't be blocked.
card.frames: 6 / 2 / 30 frames, 130 damage, grab reaches 160 units, breakable in 7 frames

card.plain: Lv 1 → Lv 2: you recover 6 frames faster, so a missed grab costs less.
card.frames: Lv 1 → Lv 2: recovery -6 (6 / 2 / 24 frames), 130 damage, grab reaches 160 units

2.notes: Proposed (open question, A4). Changes how you fight: a whiffed command grab is the Kappa's big risk (30 recovery frames in the open), so 24 makes the reach a bait you can afford to throw out, instead of a bet. Recovery still outlasts the 7-frame break window (E12). Data only: the clip tail is cut (the clip's last frames are a blend-out). Rejected: range +20% (it would stack with Whirlpool Grab's +50% and double up on the same axis), damage +10% (damage-only, P1). Overlap to decide: none with Brute Recovery (a grab is never blocked).

card.plain: A swirl of water reaches out and drags in foes from much farther away.

notes: Clip kappa-river-grab (GREYBOX reuse of the generic throw take, ryo-generic-throw / kappa-throw, Meshy preset 259, trim raw 30-59 at about 0.8x, route A of YOK-219): 6/2/30 = 38 frames = the rules.md row, no deviation. The clip's palm reach starts at raw 35, which the curve puts on frame 7 (the first active frame); Startup 6 is one frame slower than the generic throw's 5 (C4), as the table says. Command grab (YOK-225): properties.throw {range 160, breakable true, break_window 7 = C4}; the hitbox places the grab (near edge x 20, y 135, h 105, frames 7-8) and range is the reach from the origin, so the box spans x 20-160 (the generic Kappa throw reaches 140); the box width is not read, I wrote it as range - x. It never strikes, so no hitstun or blockstun. Counts as a throw (C4, R7): the trial uses a throw step, and Undertow (X4) may cancel out of the landed grab: cancel_windows frames 9-32 on hit (a held grab can't be cancelled, the sim refuses it, so the window only opens once the foe is down; at Lv 2 the move is 32 frames, so the window ends on the last frame). Recovery 30 outlasts the break window 7 (E12). Damage 130 = table. Slot C (214 / back) for a Kappa common, as Foxfire and Iron-Club Charge: a proposal, rules.md names no slot. EX (C5, E16) first pass, my proposal: +30% damage (169), as the Oni's specials; LP+LK stays the throw and wins (E12). Lv 3 Whirlpool Grab = rules table: +50% range (throw.range mul_pct 150: 160 -> 240); it keeps the Lv 2 step (E17). T0: the Tanuki casts it on Ryo's body with ryo-river-grab, the same frames; presentation needs ClipOverrides["kappa-river-grab"] = "ryo-river-grab" in FighterAnimSet.RyoBody (code, reported not changed). Forward step of the throw clip is not encoded (same open item as the generic throws, E15). Box estimates, not re-placed from the posed rig. Presets river-grab-lv1, river-grab-lv2, whirlpool-grab are named, files are Asset Smith's.
